dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a deep curvature initiating immediately below the apex and extending to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius; obtuse geometry at the convergence of leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual convex incline measured at approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of the total visible base width along the dorsal ridge to the maximum vertical height of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small V-shaped notch visible on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin, located approximately 15 percent down from the apex.
